notes.title: Editing bugs (not working siege, save), + New languages, editing languages
notes.content:
Thank you for your warm welcome to the game! We really appreciate this and even more want to do everything so that the game is the way you want to see it. We fixed the errors that you wrote about and which you sent to us:
Fixed: Bug with the eternal siege of the Picts. Previously, the Picts had a specific error due to which the assault did not start. This bug has been fixed.
Fixed: Now after saving, unit levels improve
Fixed: After saving, generals do not change the level of their bonuses
Fixed: Localization error in English (three places where Russian was instead of English)
Added: Italian language. To be honest, we were simply shocked that one of the players independently translated the entire text into Italian without our help. Such situations are inspiring - thank you very much!
Added: Portuguese language. At the moment, this translation is also made by one of the players. Perhaps the translation will require refinement, but nonetheless - thanks a lot for the translation!

We will also correct any errors you write about as quickly as possible. Thank you for support!

notes.title: Quick fix of rare bugs you wrote about (5 fixes + 1 update)
notes.content:
Some errors are very difficult to find because they are rare. For example, one error occurred only at the screen resolution used by 2% of players. Thank you for finding such errors and write to us. All errors written today are already fixed in two patches.
1. An error in which 2% of the players had the skip tutorial button overlapping the tutorial text. Now it is fixed.
2. A rare mistake when the battle did not start - fixed
3. Bug with saves - fixed
4. Some fortifications had a “attack on fortifications” bonus. This bonus has been replaced by another.
5. Syntax errors in the English language are corrected (Science and Faction).
6. Added "auto-fill" button inside the general window. Now, in the general’s window, you don’t have to click on each unit - it’s enough to use the automatic filling of empty seats in the army.
Thanks for your support! As promised - we promptly make all the necessary edits and updates. Next week you will find more updates;)

notes.title: Game launch! Update Plans (Roman fractions, Hordes, ...)

I would like to tell you what updates we plan to do.

- The mechanics of the Horde. You can create Horde at certain points in the game. In it you can hire residents of your country and neighboring countries (except for the Roman Empires). notes.content:
1. The ability to additionally select the number of starting resources when choosing a fraction. This will especially help beginners learn how to play.
2. In the generals improvement window, added information about the general himself.
3. In the unit hiring window, added additional information on your armies (how many places for units of this type are in the army, how many generals without units)

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Fortification Additions!
notes.content:
Today, in addition to the morning update, we have added another big update!
1. We added Fortifications to the game. Now you can build a special building in the region. If enemies attack the region, then this building will add defensive units - one, two or even three! In the capital, you can upgrade the Engineering building and learn new types of defensive units there. Having rebuilt these buildings, your enemies will not be able to capture regions without losses. Now the capture of each defended region will bring losses.
2. Fixed tutorial. Now it works stably.
3. Fixed save errors. Now Save / Load works as needed;)
4. Added war announcement to you. Now you will know in advance when the enemy is about to invade you
5. Corrected the display order of unit types. Now always displays infantry-arrows-cavalry-fortifications in all windows
6. Fixed a few more errors

As you can see, we are trying to improve the game and now the game has become as playable as possible;) Thank you for your support and your patience. As you can see now we have brought the game to about the kind we wanted. Although there is still a lot of work ahead)

notes.title: Global balance update (8 tables)
notes.content:
Now that the game is already stable, we started fine-tuning the balance. At the end of the week, Last Day of Rome will be ready for an active game. What is included in today's global balance update?
1. Changed the cost of studying new types of units. Now, to study new units, you need gold, not luxury. The price is also slightly reduced.
2. Improvements to barracks, firing ranges and stables are now cheaper. Recall that these buildings are needed to study new types of units.
3. Each unit added bonus "The cost of building a unit costs less than recruits." This bonus is extremely strong, because the deprivation of any unit of this bonus actually means that they will not be played by this unit. Nevertheless, the game has 5% of units that have two such bonuses - so they will be especially relevant.
4. Recalculated the value of different levels of units for AI. Higher units are now rated as much more important. The higher the level of the unit, the higher the value (when evaluating the enemy and when evaluating the feasibility of improving their own units)
5. Redesigned AI. Now he invests less in the development of the region. Previously, AI put too much effort into regional development.
6. Building Infrastructure in the regions now brings a lot more population. Completely rebuilt infrastructure previously provided +40.000 population, and now +155.000.
7. The increase in population growth from the building "Suburb" in the capital. Previously, 2 and higher levels brought +100.000 each. Now they bring in +200.000. The population is an extremely important parameter, because only he can give recruits. Therefore, we decided to add this parameter.
8. The remaining buildings in the capital also bring more population growth.
The balance adjustment process is the most painstaking part of the project. Also today or tomorrow we will add another big update to the game.
Thanks for your support ;)

notes.title: Second big update in one day! 7 more points
notes.content:
Today we are releasing another update that has been prepared for a long time. I would like to make that game more quickly, which I would like to play again and again)
- Added: Victory Points. Now you will receive points for the capture of regions, for an earlier victory, for the studied sciences.
- Added: Hall of Fame. Now all your records will be stored in the Hall of Fame and you can compare yourself with historical leaders.
- Changed: Fraction selection window. Now you can see much more information about the selected fraction. Each fraction will have only 1 difficulty. In fact, the choice of fraction is the choice of complexity. Therefore, each faction will have its own victory points ratio.
- Added: In the window "All regions" we now display the names of the provinces and the population of the regions
- Added: Luxury Choice. Now, during the construction of luxury buildings, you yourself choose which type of luxury you want to produce. Given that during the game, certain types of luxury vary greatly in price - you can choose those resources that are especially expensive.
- Added: General units add button. On the sidebar of the generals, added the "+" button when clicked on which we open the profile of the general
- Fixed: Displaying the value of bonuses in sciences and unit levels. Previously, players saw the bonus value 100 times less than in reality. A realistic bonus value is now displayed.

notes.title: One more huge update (10 points)!
notes.content:
Now we are trying to clean the game from bugs as much as possible. Until the end of the week we will deal with everyone.
What do we have in today's update?

- Added: Unit healing functionality. Now in the "Generals" window you can heal all your units for gold. You wrote about this change - so we did it;)
- Added: Defeat in the game.
- Added: Different victory conditions for different factions. Now, a faction with initially difficult starting positions for victory needs to capture fewer regions and it will receive much more victory points
- Added: General's age. The general is now aging and may die. Aging speed - 1 turn = 1 month

- Changed: Unit bonuses. Previously, some units had strong bonuses for reducing the cost of building units, which made them especially strong. Now such bonuses are distributed more evenly.
- Changed: Bonuses in the sciences. Previously, some of the bonuses were for functionality that has not yet been implemented in the game. Now all bonuses in the sciences are working. Also, bonuses in the sciences have strengthened and now they play a much larger role.
- Changed: A bit simplified AI. Previously, he was demonically strong. Nevertheless, the most complex fractions (with one starting region) are still incredibly complex.

- Fixed: In general’s improvements, when pumping two identical improvements, only one of them worked for one unit. Now all the upgraded improvements work.
- Fixed: Error when the attack of two different factions on the same region led to an eternal siege. Now if you besiege a region and it is captured by another faction with which you are not at war, then the siege is simply lifted.
- Fixed: Two bugs related to the unification of generals in the "Marshals"
Another big update in the evening. And until the end of the week we plan a fully stable version of the game. Thank you for supporting us!

notes.title: The most global update! (Recycling battle and unit recruitment)
notes.content:
1. Substantial revision of the generals. Now, before the battle, the system unites all attacking generals into one and all defensive ones. It also unites units of the same type during the battle into one, increasing their "health" (strength). So now all fights will take place at most 12 to 12 - without several consecutive battles for the same region. It will also solve the error that sometimes occurred during an attack by several generals.
2. Redesigned the system of hiring units. Earlier, after you put the unit in the queue for hire, you had to wait at least a move until it became available. Now units are hired immediately, without waiting. This will significantly reduce the routine.
3. Added icons to improve the level of units. Now for each improvement has its own unique icon.
4. During the battle, auto completion was added if the player made all available actions. This will make the battle more dynamic.
5. In the information window on the opponent’s general, they added the name of the fraction and its coat of arms.
6. During the battle, the display of the damage coefficient, we show when you hover on your card.
7. Fixed a bug with iron for the first fraction.

notes.title: Huge update (260 Mb) and the announcement of a new update!
notes.content:
We have just added a new update according to your wishes. I am very pleased with your activity and your recommendations for improvement. We follow your wishes and the game is really getting better.
You had a lot of questions about the global map. Most of all - how to attack with your generals. We have added new functionality that should throw away all the questions.
- Now the icons of your generals will be displayed on the left. In order to select the general, just click on this icon. When you click on the general icon:
--- The camera will focus on your general
--- This general will be selected
--- Regions you can send this general will be marked in Green
--- The dotted line will highlight the line between the cursor and the general - so that you understand that clicking on an area will send the general to that area.
This should remove the basic questions of “how to manage a general” and “how to send a general to another region in an attack” and others.
- Also next to the general’s icon will be indicated what his status is now.
If your general besieges the region of the enemy, then it will be indicated exactly how many turns are left before the battle
If your region has been attacked, an icon will appear under the generals how many turns are left before the battle to defend your region
- In addition, we pay a lot of attention to the visual part. Some players complained that the city was too monotonous and colorless. Unfortunately, we pursued historicity and made the city as similar as possible to that time. But of course, buildings in the capital should be more different from each other. Therefore, today we are updating half of the buildings with updated colors. Now each building will look more individual.

We also work all week on save / downloads. I think that on Monday or Tuesday we can finally add them and take on a completely redone tutorial. I am sure you will like the new training - we have already seriously worked it out.

notes.title: First big update
notes.content:
Thanks for your support. We want to spend a lot more work with the game and of course with your help we will get a game that will be a pleasure to play. At the moment you see the most important thing - the basic idea of ​​the game and the incredible design that our guys managed to create.
What today includes the Monday update?
We follow all your wishes, because we have removed from the game all the incomprehensible moments and slightly simplified the game in the most difficult aspects:
1. Now to improve military buildings do not need the study of science. Instead, we increased the price of upgrading the barracks, the stables and the shooting range.
Now, to get access to the units of the new type you need
- improve the appropriate building (barracks for infantry, stable for cavalry, shooting range for archers)
- examine the available type of units
2. Previously, to build more than one luxury mining building in the region, you had to perform a special action - to capture the entire province or to study a certain science. Now these additional restrictions are not present - you can build the second and third building of mining of luxury when you have enough workers and resources.
3. Changed science and added more bonuses automatic unconditional mining in the regions.
We also added notices - when entering the region, information about construction in the region pops up.
Plus we fixed several bugs (including rare battle bug)
We continue to work actively. In the near future, we will add updates on the global map and on other elements.
Thanks again for your support. New large indie projects can only appear with the support of the community. And it's nice that you try to help as much as possible. From our side we will do our best.

notes.title: Scale updates! The size of the game has grown from 1 GB to 1.6 GB
notes.content:
Over the last month we have made a serious breakthrough both in quality of the game and the functionality. Suffice to say that the size of the game has grown from 980 MB to 1670 MB. I will describe just a list of what we had during this time:
- New global map. We also almost finished the display of generals on the map in the form of animated 3D units.
- Significant improvement in the capital. We added an animated camera to the city, as well as a lot of animations (such as chopping wood, fishing and other small animations). Also added to the capital of the second weather - rain. This adds a lot of entourage).
- Finalization of the levels of units. Now each unit can have 10 levels of improvement. At each level, the player will be able to choose which direction to improve this type of unit.
- Combining generals. Implemented the creation of large compounds of generals in the marshals. Now you will not need to spend 5 battles one by one. You will be able to hold really massive battles.
Also processing a large number of windows, small and large items.
The game has become much bigger and more complete.
At the same time, the start of Early Access will not stop the flow of changes. We plan to expand the game after the Early Access by adding a lot of global changes as well as smaller ones. But here we will need your help. Your advice about where and what to change - will be extremely important to us. So we hope for your support and that we will work together on the "Last Day of Rome".
